rubric.role_summary: Developer experience software engineer working on codebase structure, build and test pipelines, developer tooling, and workflows across a polyglot engineering organization.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Developer experience software engineer working on codebase structure, build and test pipelines, developer tooling, and workflows across a polyglot engineering organization.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Strong proficiency in TypeScript and/or Go and/or Nix.
- Expertise in modern build systems and toolchains; Vite, webpack, esbuild, and Go's build/module system are examples, not individually required.
- Experience with developer tooling such as linters, formatters, testing frameworks, or code generation tools.
- Experience managing monorepos or large-scale codebases.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience building self-service developer platforms used by many engineering teams.
- Experience with AI-native development workflows.
- Open-source leadership or community contributions.
- Proficiency with linters, formatters, testing frameworks, and code generation tools.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.
